items.summary: Maintain a bounded site-factory pipeline for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Each candidate remains preview-only until a site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, owner evidence, security review, measurement plan, rollback path, and launch gate are complete. Do not add domains, spend, deploy, or launch. Strongest candidate: complicated.work, tied at score 84 and already covered by an owner-gap work item. Exactly one next step: site-factory verifies and attaches dated execution-owner evidence for complicated.work; preserve parked/private status until that evidence and all launch gates exist.
